{{Quote|Fighters incoming. Gold Two and Five on me for the trench. The rest of the squad, engage the TIEs. Hold them off.|Jon Vander gives orders to Okand and the rest of Gold Squadron|<ref name="Sparks">{{StoryCite|story=Sparks (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>}}
'''Hol Okand'''<ref name="AMG" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[starfighter]] [[pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Okand was a member of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] within the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]]. In the moments before the Battle of Yavin, Okand entered a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]] with the aid of two [[Rebel technician|technicians]]  within the [[Great Temple]]. He was supplied a [[Flight helmet|flight helmet]] by the ground tech on his port-side, and subsequently began the take off process after the cockpit canopy was sealed.<ref name="ANH" /> However, Okand piloted a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] as part of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] during the engagement itself.<ref name="AMG" /> By the battle's conclusion, he had been [[Death|killed]] above the [[Death Star]], along with all the other members of his [[squadron]], except for [[Evaan Verlaine]].<ref name="Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hol Okand first appeared as an unnamed Rebel Pilot in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> He was later identified and given a brief backstory in the ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], published in [[November]] of [[1998]].<ref name="Gold 6">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 6}}</ref> Although ''[[Decipher]]'' established that he was a member of Gold Squadron, a primarily Y-Wing filled squadron, Okand himself is seen sitting in a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] in the film.<ref name="ANH" />
